negationTests.compatibility: Corrected SORT_CARD transport and public CHAININFO mapping. Candidate modifies loaded Lua only.

nativeProcedure.linkTwo: Mandatory lower trigger makes Scarlet Link 2. Native Special Summon starts after Link 2 resolves and before Link 1 begins. The summon-negating trap is unavailable.
nativeProcedure.cleanup: The installed procedure unregisters when used. Chain-end operation removes any remaining procedure and ATK listener. Forced rejection was exercised in the Scarlet test-only prototype.
nativeProcedure.selection: The zero selector presents both the card’s own procedure and the temporary procedure. A distinct numeric selector avoids this prompt and selects the instructed procedure.
nativeProcedure.integration: Six installed CCG scripts use a distinct numeric selector. No exact generic Special Summon type equality found in canonical Lua. Public core bitmask check accepts the Special Summon category. Live Omega and the full stock-library consumer space are unverified.

familyQualification: Candidate tests use the native summon skeleton. Exploring required the selected card’s actual Hand/Deck range and applied its Deck-only negate on native summon success. The distinct selector and cleanup are separately verified on Scarlet and still need production batch integration.
